title: Winter to summer
notes: The path and trigger of 03b-tram.json in a summer state made in memory and never saved: a time jump to 08:00, climate temperature 26, sim speed 8; the valley was green within about one game hour (high ground keeps rock and some snow). The edit dissolves from a 03b winter take to a 14 summer take in the middle of the move. Take 1: descending cabin on the far rope (started at x 2943.6, slightly late), Time of Day 15. Take 2: the other cabin on the near rope (started at x 2951.9), Time of Day 14.5. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
